TC-24/S17.title: Double tap on a task's delete: one task_deleted (TFA-94514 cell)
TC-24/S17.detail: Our own addition; only the task cell (1), which the TFA-92579 review assigns to TFA-94514. Local Playwright spec newspec-c/an2-tc24-s17-double-delete.spec.ts, Hospital Encounter tab, five fixture tasks in order (Recheck BMP in AM, PT eval before discharge, Call daughter re: goals of care, Repeat CBC, Repeat CBC). A double tap on 'Delete task: Recheck BMP in AM' wrote two task_deleted rows because it deleted two tasks: the second tap landed on 'PT eval before discharge', which had slid into the tapped spot, and deleted it as well; no confirmation appeared (0 dialogs). One delete of the second 'Repeat CBC' wrote one more row (3 in all; 'Repeat CBC' kept once; left: Call daughter re: goals of care, Repeat CBC). The analytics side is consistent (one task_deleted per task actually deleted), but cell (1)'s 'the task that slid into place stays' fails, and that is data loss, so under Quinn's bar this own-addition finding counts as a bug, not a suggestion. A delete that asks once (TFA-94699 AC 6, in progress) would also stop it; routing is for Quinn.
TC-24/S17.productIssue: A quick double tap on a task's trash icon (Hospital Encounter tab) deletes that task and the next one in the list, with no confirmation and no undo: the physician loses a task they never tapped.
